explicit_exceptions.reason: Credential bootstrap and browser session transport precede authenticated domain tools; MCP uses bearer authentication.
Deployment liveness and service installation/startup are transport or operator concerns, not domain CRUD.
MCP initialization/discovery/session/resource transport is protocol infrastructure; no simulated dashboard button or MCP wrapper is required.
Shipped static reference files are convenience downloads, not private workspace records; agents may use REST or repository examples.

explicit_exceptions.dashboard: Read context/history; create new revisions or delete the owning attempt
explicit_exceptions.reason: Frozen contexts and lifecycle history have no arbitrary PATCH/DELETE. Document content changes create revisions; approved revisions stay immutable. Context deletion is scoped to deleting the owning application/job.
Logical file actions are equivalent across interfaces; raw HTTP bytes use scoped grants rather than base64 MCP payloads. Backup/export use their own scoped operational grants.

logical_transport_equivalence: Single-source Run once and Remove use sources/bulk with one versioned item; they perform the same source service operations.
Source configuration is read from full source list records; a separate sources/{id} request is unnecessary for the human operation.
Context detail/signature is downloaded as a complete frozen JSON snapshot instead of rendered as an editable form.
File upload/download use ordinary raw HTTP transfers; transport-grant mechanics are not separately exposed as forms.
Domain lists remain scoped to relevant job/application/knowledge/template navigation rather than an unstructured API console.

visual_review.career1920: Two meaningful desktop columns; professional links span the left card width; metadata occupies a separate full-width row.
visual_review.collection390: Single-column content; navigation stays hidden until opened; cards/actions remain inside viewport; no material positioning defect.

resolved_gaps.evidence: ApplicationDrawer and DocumentEditor call /contexts with defaultlimit100 and no paging/allPages. Older snapshots cannot be selected/downloaded on attempts with>100contexts.
resolved_gaps.resolution: Both saved-context history and document context chooser now request compact20-item pages. History offset is URL-preserved; controlled selected context ID/label survives paging to another page.

resolved_gaps.evidence: DocumentCard displays title/date/review state but never revision_number. Same-title same-day revisions cannot be distinguished by their supplied chain number.
resolved_gaps.resolution: Document cards/details show backend revision_number; revision editor states the prior revision number.

additional_numeric_parity: Manual number-answer inputs use step=any; real3.75 value passed HTML validation and persisted as a numeric backend answer.
